name: Sikalastic®-100 EP Primer
tagline: Solvent free epoxy primer for use with Sikalastic® membrane systems
summary: Sikalastic®-100 EP Primer is a two component, 100% solids epoxy primer designed for use with various Sikalastic® membrane systems. Sikalastic®-100 EP Primer is low viscosity and promotes substrate penetration to provide excellent adhesion in demanding applications.
metaDescription: Sikalastic®-100 EP Primer is a two component, 100% solids epoxy primer designed for use with various Sikalastic® membrane systems. Sikalastic®-100 EP Primer is low viscosity and promotes substrate penetration to provide excellent adhesion in demanding applications.

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text: AS4020:2018- Approved for use in contact with potable drinking water

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: Stored in original sealed containers within the temperature range of +5 to +35 degress C, this product will keep for a minimum of 3 years

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: The packaging must be stored properly in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging, in dry conditions at temperatures between +5°C and +30°C.

items.label: Mixing ratio
items.text: 2:1 (Part A: Part B) by volume and mass

items.label: Waiting time to overcoating
items.text:
10°C- 15 hours
20°C- 8 hours
All membrane applications should be applied within a maximum 36-48 hour time period depending on temperature/UV exposure

items.label: Consumption
items.text:
Primer:
5-6m2 per Litre approx. (CSP profile 2-3)
2-3m2 per Litre approx. (CSP profile 4-5)
Patching compound:
Between 1:5 - 1:8 (mixed litre of Sikalastic®-100 EP Primer: kg of blended silica sand)

items.label: MIXING
items.text: 2:1 mix ratio (Part A: Part B) mixed for a minimum of 2 minutes

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Clean all tools and application equipment with Thinner C immediately after use. Hardened and/or cured material can only be removed mechanically.
